repository_resolution: The isolated six-tool Mise environment passed exact installation/version checks and the native check task. The repository still has no accepted mise.lock or complete sidecars; their promotion and independent-machine bootstrap remain unqualified. Poppler has a qualified Homebrew Bundle declaration/check/execution binding described in pdf_inspection, not an exact-version lock. Native tasks install nothing; Homebrew remains the host installation owner.

font_supply.typst: Songti SC and Charter from macOS; Noto Sans CJK SC from its existing Homebrew cask; DejaVu Sans Mono embedded in Typst 0.15.1; Apple Color Emoji from macOS as the observed emoji fallback.
font_supply.mermaid_browser: publication/mermaid.json selects Noto Sans CJK SC, which must be available to the selected headless browser. The other Typst families are not declared diagram requirements.
font_supply.closure: The bound replay checks six actual font files, the exact compiler with its embedded fonts, and all eight complete package roots through publication/typst-inputs.sha256. Typst inputs.json still omits font reads. Same-host, network-disabled replay equals the delivered PDF byte-for-byte with exact edition-bound diagram bytes; extra supplied files and second-machine reproduction remain unqualified.
font_supply.rights: No standalone font binaries are included in repository source. Delivered PDFs embed used font faces; each font retains its own terms. See publication/third-party-notices.md.

pdf_inspection.locked_repository_resolution: publication/brewfile declares Poppler. The native pdf-tool task checks the installed bundle and executes commands through brew bundle exec; pdf-tools-check verifies pdfinfo and pdftotext and gates test and bootstrap. This binding and the native check pass on the authoring host without installation or upgrade. The Brewfile does not lock the exact package version; independent-machine bootstrap remains unqualified.

mermaid_browser: Use Puppeteer's supported browser, or select an existing compatible browser with PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH. Record its identity with the build; never use a personal browser profile or disable the sandbox.
diagram_replay: The native diagram task selects --disable-gpu through publication/puppeteer.json and Mermaid's supported Puppeteer launch configuration. With Mermaid CLI 12.2.0 and Chrome 157.0.8103.51, two independent renders of all seven figures were byte-identical; the native-task regression checks repeated output against a same-input software reference. This changes real raster pixels while preserving observed SVG geometry. Cross-machine stability and the exact browser-internal cause remain unproved. pdf-isolated consumes current images without freezing or checksumming them; exact prior-edition replay still requires that edition's frozen image bindings. The renderer/supply successor passed bounded technical qualification and stated author visual self-review, then identical local delivery. Actual-reader successor navigation and human editorial/teaching acceptance remain unverified; no substantive manuscript rewrite is implied.
reproduction: The source avoids private machine bindings, but the current layout depends on macOS font supply and has not qualified a second-machine build. Matching compiler, actual font files, browser, complete resolved packages, diagram inputs and fixed document date are reproduction prerequisites, not a byte-identical guarantee. A font substitution requires relayout and successor acceptance.
